name: Pholedrine
summary: Pholedrine, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-methylamphetamine and sold under the brand names Paredrinol, Pulsotyl, and Veritol among others, is a sympathomimetic drug used in topical eye drops to dilate the pupil. It can be used to diagnose Horner's syndrome.

pharmacology.text: Pholedrine is described as a sympathomimetic, antihypotensive, and ephedrine-like agent.

uses.text: Pholedrine, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-methylamphetamine and sold under the brand names Paredrinol, Pulsotyl, and Veritol among others, is a sympathomimetic drug used in topical eye drops to dilate the pupil. It can be used to diagnose Horner's syndrome. In 2004, it remained marketed only in Germany.

sideEffects.en: As eye drops it can sting and cause light sensitivity. Taken into the body it acts as a weak stimulant and can raise blood pressure and heart rate.
sideEffects.zh: 作為眼藥水使用時可能有刺痛感並造成畏光。若進入體內，它是弱效興奮劑，可能使血壓與心跳上升。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为眼药水使用时可能有刺痛感并造成畏光。若进入体内，它是弱效兴奋剂，可能使血压与心跳上升。

fact.en: Like hydroxyamphetamine, it was used as eye drops to work out where a problem in the nerve supply to the pupil lies.
fact.zh: 與 4-羥基安非他命一樣，它曾作為眼藥水使用，用來判斷瞳孔神經供應的問題出在哪一段。
fact.zhHans: 与 4-羟基安非他命一样，它曾作为眼药水使用，用来判断瞳孔神经供应的问题出在哪一段。
